title: Owner-Restricted Settings — reference solution and review guide
answer: A strong Owner-Restricted Settings solution should meet the objective: Guard a settings update with an owner check, and prove in tests that a non-owner call fails. Document the ownership trust assumption. It should use a repeatable local test setup and explain why the selected rules preserve the intended behavior.
explanation: Review technical correctness, authorization, boundary behavior, repeatability, and limitation statements. Do not treat a passing demo as a comprehensive security assessment.

review_rubric.criterion: Technical correctness and fit to task
